LanguageData.FAF_ThermostatOpenDesc: Set the target temperature and manage the battery and optional coolant reserve.
LanguageData.FAF_ThermostatCoolantBackupDesc: Uses coolant for cooling only, and only when neither the grid nor the internal battery can supply it. Heating requires electricity.
LanguageData.FAF_ThermostatBatteryFlowDesc: The battery's net change includes charging, supplying the power grid and self-discharge. Temperature-control demand is shown separately.
LanguageData.FAF_ThermostatWireAutomatic: Automatic conduit connection (adjacent or within 6 cells)
LanguageData.FAF_CoolantBackupDisabled: Enable coolant backup in the thermostat before adding coolant.
LanguageData.FAF_NoCoolantHauler: No available hauler can refuel this cabinet. Check coolant supply, access and reservations.
LanguageData.FAF_CoolantFractionRetained: No whole unused bottle remains. The partial bottle stays in the reserve; coolant backup is now disabled.
LanguageData.FAF_RapidThermalControlDesc: Multiply active thermal output and electricity demand by {0}. Backup coolant use increases by the same factor only when cooling. Passive insulation is unchanged.
LanguageData.FAF_CoolantReserveFull: The refill target is reached, or less than one whole bottle fits.
LanguageData.FAF_CoolingRegulatorDesc: Set a refrigeration or freezing target for the base freezer.
LanguageData.FAF_CabinetUnavailable: This freezer is no longer available for management.
LanguageData.FAF_ThermostatDemandDesc: Maintenance offsets adverse outside temperatures. In normal mode, temperature adjustment adds 120 W until the target is reached, then switches to maintenance. Resources are used only while control is powered; without a usable source, the temperature drifts naturally. Rapid control increases both speed and demand. Coolant cannot provide heat.
